paite: Huan Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun tapa khenkhat kaihgingte, pekgingte, dakkhutbette toh ala vek a nasemmi ding in David leh sepaih heutute'n ahihtuam ua; nasep ding omdan bang zel in nasem mite tamdan ding asep uhi.
heading: Tempul A Lasa Mite

paite: Asaph tapate lak a mi Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah leh Asarelah ahi ua, amau bel Asaph tapate, kumpipa thupiak bang a zawlnei thugen a gen, Asaph thuthu a omte ahi uh.
Jeduthun lak ah: Jeduthun tapate Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah leh Matithiahte, guk ahi uh; kaihging toh TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen a la vek a apa uh Jeduthun thuthu a omte ahi uh.
Heman lak ah: Heman tapate Bukkiah, Mataniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanni, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Malothi, Hothir leh Mahaziothte ahi uhi;
Huaite tengteng Pathian lam thu a kumpipa zawlnei Heman tapate pengkulkawi mut dingte ahi uh. Pathian in Heman tapa sawm-le-li leh tanu thum apia hi.

Huaite tengteng TOUPA' inn a dakkhutbet toh, kaihging toh, pekging toh, Pathian inn a nasepna ding a la toh lem mite, apa uh thuthu a omte ahi uh; Asaph, Jeduthun leh Hemante bel kumpipa thupiak iak a omte ahi leuleu uhi.
Atamlam uh, a-unau, TOUPA ding a lasak kisin siam khinsa tengtengte toh zanih sawmgiat-le-giat ahi uh.
Huan aneu leh alian, sinsakmi leh sinmi in atan ding uh kibang vek in ai asan uhi.
Huchi in aisan akhatveina Asaph tapa Joseph tung ah atu a; anihveina Gedaliah tung ah; amah leh a-unaute leh atapate sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
